item1_mechanism.name: Episodic-depth (turnover-burst concentration) premium
item1_mechanism.statement: The shape of turnover within a week - how concentrated trading is into a few 15-minute bursts versus spread smoothly across the 2688 slots - measures the rhythm at which liquidity is provided. Burst-concentrated names have episodically displayed depth: quotes are pulled between bursts, market-maker inventory risk per unit of standing time spikes, and a position holder's exit liquidity depends on the next burst arriving. The holder is the residual supplier of continuity between bursts and bears a recurring episodic-liquidity risk that must be compensated by a higher expected return. Smooth-turnover names let market makers rotate inventory against a steady tape; continuity is cheap and the premium small.
item1_mechanism.economic_counterparty: episodic takers (burst-initiated flow) versus liquidity providers and the between-burst holder who supplies continuity
item1_mechanism.why_edge_exists: liquidity-provision risk is priced (Nagel 2012 RFS; crypto liquidity-provision premium, JBF 2025; positioning-structure futures premia, Bessembinder 1992); burst concentration is a persistent 28d-scale structural property of a name's flow, not news
item1_mechanism.expected_sign: the 5 symbols with the HIGHEST 28d normalized turnover-burst concentration outperform the cross-section mean and BTC buy-and-hold after costs (holders of episodically-liquid names earn the continuity premium)
item1_mechanism.funding_role: COST ONLY, never a signal; the signal contains no return, no price-difference and no OI term - price enters only as a same-bar deflator of volume (dollar volume), available at the bar close stamp

item2_falsifiable_prediction.no_rescue_clause: any single falsifier rejects the family; no window retune, sign flip, per-symbol cost exemption or universe carve-out afterwards

item4_pit_observable.authority: fusion-record availability semantics: a decision at T never reads a record with available_time_utc > T; retrieval time never substitutes for availability; as-of selection via frozen VintageSeries.select rank (available_time_utc <= vintage_time_utc <= retrieved_time_utc)

fields.availability: bar close boundary ts_event; per-slot dollar volume v_i*c_i uses the SAME bar's close as deflator so it is available exactly at that bar's close
fields.use: turnover-shape signal, control's daily log returns, benchmark/beta series, fill marks
cost marks only, never a signal

item4_pit_observable.signal: over trailing 28d of 15m slots: p_i = v_i*c_i / sum_j v_j*c_j; HHI_norm = n_slots * sum_i p_i^2 (1 = uniform, n_slots = single-slot concentration); scale-free, sign-free shape LEVEL statistic; no return, no OI, no funding term in the ranking

item5_universe_clock_execution.universe: 20 frozen required symbols minus BTCUSDT = 19 tradable USD-M perpetuals; BTCUSDT benchmark/context only
item5_universe_clock_execution.eligibility_per_stamp: complete trailing 28d (anchor) / 56d (neighbour) of completed 15m bars; ineligible symbols excluded that stamp; book renormalizes at equal weight 1/N across eligible names; N >= 4 satisfies |w| <= 0.30 by construction (1/4 = 0.25); N < 4 scales gross down to keep |w| <= 0.30 at every stamp
item5_universe_clock_execution.warmup: binding 90d (BTC-beta context) per frozen warmup table (anchor_28d, neighbour_56d, beta_90d); satisfied from authorized pre-screen history 2024-08-20..2025-08-22
item5_universe_clock_execution.decision_clock: every Monday 00:00:00Z (weekly-or-slower; 52/365d <= 60 frozen floor); book carried between stamps; forced-flat only at fold boundaries
item5_universe_clock_execution.folds: F0/F1/F2 chronological over blind-S0 window 2025-08-22..2026-08-21 with frozen 1-day purge; first stamp of each fold strictly after the purge boundary
item5_universe_clock_execution.execution_lag_declared_single: fill at the close of the first completed 15m bar with close time STRICTLY AFTER the decision stamp = Monday 00:15:00Z; stress adds +1 event delay = Monday 00:30:00Z
item5_universe_clock_execution.holding: 7d intended (weekly cadence; >= 3d median floor); full target-book rebalance at stamps only

anchor.construction: rank 19 eligible symbols DESCENDING on HHI_norm over trailing 28d; long the 5 HIGHEST at 0.20 each, gross 1.0

neighbour.justification: episodic-provision regimes persist at quarterly scale; 56d averages over more weekly cycles; stays inside the frozen warmup table (neighbour_56d)

causal_negative_control.construction: identical pipeline; ranking on trailing 28d realized volatility of daily log returns (authorized 15m bars, PIT stamps) DESCENDING; long the 5 HIGHEST-vol names
causal_negative_control.rival_explanation_tested: bursty names outperform simply because they are high-volatility names (vol-level sorting - a shadow-observation-adjacent rival deliberately placed in the CONTROL seat, never proposed as the mechanism)
causal_negative_control.preregistered_rule_control_must_not_repr: control reproduction := VOLREG-28D passes after-cost expectancy > 0 AND its per-fold buy-and-hold-excess signs match the anchor's in >= 2/3 folds; if reproduction occurs the causal attribution FAILS and LIQPRO is INELIGIBLE for selection even if the anchor passes every Stage-A gate; the control arm can never be promoted from this proposal

item7_incremental_test.buy_and_hold_benchmark: BTCUSDT buy-and-hold at matched gross from the same authorized bars under the same fusion availability stamps; per-fold weekly excess
item7_incremental_test.btc_beta_context: trailing 90d daily beta of the arm vs BTC (authorized bars, PIT stamps; frozen beta_90d warmup); beta-adjusted excess per fold
item7_incremental_test.gate_frozen: BOTH excess measures positive in >= 2/3 folds; raw-pass + beta-context-fail means BTC beta in disguise -> REJECT

item8_costs_floors_concentration_dropone.base_costs: generic adapter fee + slippage on fills only; native funding settlements while held enter exactly once as a COST
item8_costs_floors_concentration_dropone.stress: fee x1.5, +2 adverse ticks (instrument tick sizes), +1 event delay
item8_costs_floors_concentration_dropone.concentration: largest-symbol positive-PnL share <= 0.70 enforced as the frozen Stage-A gate; equal-weight quintile construction bounds per-swap notional at 0.20 of gross; bursty names' wider effective spreads are handled ONLY by the uniform frozen schedule - any per-symbol cost exemption is a forbidden rescue pattern and is not sought
item8_costs_floors_concentration_dropone.sample_floors: 52 scheduled stamps/yr; frozen minimum-activity convention (zero-position baseline refused at publication); a stamp with fewer than 4 eligible symbols carries the book unchanged and is still counted
item8_costs_floors_concentration_dropone.drop_one: at each decision stamp the perturbed schedule drops the single HELD symbol with MAXIMUM |weight| for that holding span; flat book = VACUOUS; gates require non-vacuous drop-one symbol survival AND fold survival (dropping any single fold must not flip the family verdict)
